faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) for filling up legal consultant vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Consultant (Legal) under the Ministry of External Affairs.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Consultant (Legal) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Law along with at least 05 years of experience in the legal field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years for general candidates and up to 63 years for retired Government of India servants.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a maximum salary of Rs. 10,00,000/- per annum on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through offline mode by sending the filled form via registered post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed application forms is 26-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by candidates applying for this Ministry of External Affairs recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I visit for official updates?
faq.answer: Applicants can visit the official Ministry of External Affairs website at https://www.mea.gov.in for regular updates and notifications.
